transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um... hi. Well, I guess... the main thing is work. I process insurance claims, and lately... I just keep getting up from my desk. Like, I know I need to sit there and finish reviewing them, but... I just can't seem to stay in my seat.
Besides getting up from your desk, do you also often blurt things out before other people finish speaking?
No... not really. I don't think I do that.
Do you often interrupt other people while they are talking?
Um... no. I don't think I do. I usually just... let people finish talking.
Do you often have trouble sustaining your attention when you are doing work or other tasks?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't think so. It's mostly just... what I said before, about getting up from my desk a lot.
Do you often feel restless, like you have to move around or can’t sit still?
Um... not really. I don't feel restless or anything like that. I can sit still fine, I just... end up getting up from my desk sometimes. But I don't feel like I have to move.
